meta.title: Context Toolkit
meta.description: Run code in a sandbox, file large material into a local searchable knowledge base, and block the fetches and whole-file reads that flood a conversation. Ships a live context-occupancy panel.

strings.title: Context Toolkit
strings.description: Run code in a sandbox, file large material into a local searchable knowledge base, and block the fetches and whole-file reads that flood a conversation. Ships a live context-occupancy panel.
strings.hint: These switches apply immediately, no restart: the gate is read before every tool call.
strings.routingHint: Master switch. When on, every tool call passes through the gate before running.
strings.denyCurlWgetHint: Both exist to paste whole responses into the conversation; blocked here, use ctk_fetch_and_index instead.
strings.bashNudgeMinCommandBytesHint: Commands longer than this get a nudge toward ctk_batch_execute. 0 disables it.
strings.maxReadBytesBeforeAskHint: Reading a file larger than this gets a nudge toward ctk_execute_file. 0 disables it.
strings.trustedReadBasenames: Filenames exempt from the read nudge
strings.trustedReadBasenamesHint: Comma separated; these may be read whole however large they are.
strings.compressNudgeTokensHint: At this surface occupancy the report suggests compaction. 0 disables it.
strings.searchLimitHint: How many excerpts ctk_search returns per query.
strings.snippetCharsHint: Character ceiling on each excerpt from ctk_search.
strings.fetchMaxBytesHint: ctk_fetch_and_index keeps at most this many bytes of each page.
strings.toolsHint: Enable or disable individual ctk_* tools.
strings.unavailable: The plugin is not loaded right now; it cannot be configured.
strings.saveFailed: This deployment did not accept those values; they are kept for you to edit.
strings.invalidNumber: Numbers only; blank means the default.
strings.note: Gate switches apply immediately; reopen the page to confirm tool-switch changes.
strings.ctxNoSession: No measurable projection in this session yet.
strings.ctxStale: Snapshot from the last real measurement ({time}): a page request has no session boundary; ask ctk_context_report in the conversation for a live reading.
strings.ctxOver: Above the warning threshold — route bulk output through ctk_execute / ctk_index.
strings.ctxUnder: Below the warning threshold; nothing to do.
strings.ctxLedgerLine: The gate blocked {n} calls, about {bytes} bytes kept out of context; the sandbox kept out {sandbox} bytes; {tools} ctk_* tools registered.
strings.tools.execute: ctk_execute (run code in the sandbox, return only the answer)
strings.tools.executeHint: For analysis where you want the conclusion, not the raw output.
strings.tools.executeFile: ctk_execute_file (run code over a file, return only the answer)
strings.tools.executeFileHint: Read a big file, compute over it, keep its bytes in the sandbox.
strings.tools.batchExecute: ctk_batch_execute (many commands in one call, per-command status)
strings.tools.batchExecuteHint: One call for many commands; only conclusions come back.
strings.tools.index: ctk_index (file large material into the local knowledge base)
strings.tools.indexHint: Archive long docs, logs or specs, then pull sections with ctk_search.
strings.tools.search: ctk_search (retrieve excerpts on demand, not the whole thing)
strings.tools.searchHint: Prefer this for material already in the knowledge base.
strings.tools.fetchAndIndex: ctk_fetch_and_index (fetch a page straight into the index)
strings.tools.fetchAndIndexHint: When a whole page would flood the conversation; curl/wget are gated.
strings.tools.purgeHint: Clears the knowledge base; permanent, so the call must confirm:true.
strings.tools.stats: ctk_stats (this plugin's savings ledger and knowledge usage)
strings.tools.statsHint: How much this plugin saved, and how much it filed.
strings.tools.doctor: ctk_doctor (self-check: runtimes, scratch dir, knowledge round-trip)
strings.tools.doctorHint: Run it first when a child process or indexing misbehaves.
strings.tools.contextReportHint: Lets the model ask for this session context occupancy and composition.
